caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional bust of a female figure with long, dark hair styled in a braid or twist that rests over her shoulder. She is wearing a blue garment with billowing sleeves, and the fabric is rendered with visible folds and wrinkles. The figure is holding a small pink object, resembling a fruit or a flower, in her right hand raised near her mouth, and another similar pink object is held in her left hand at waist level. The lower portion of the bust, especially the blue garment, displays areas of brown discoloration, suggesting damage or weathering. The background is plain and unadorned, in a light cream color, with no additional objects or scenery present in the composition. The drawing is rendered with careful shading and attention to texture, particularly in the hair, face, and worn areas of the clothing.
title: Figurehead
